build_clip_vision_transformer: build a CLIP Vision Transformer that encodes image patches into hidden state embeddings
create_clip_loss: create a CLIP contrastive loss that computes image-caption matching from a similarity matrix
run_clip_encoder: run a CLIP Transformer encoder with optional local attention and image grouping
test_clip_attention: test multi-headed self-attention with query, key, value projections and causal masking
review_clip_mlp: review a CLIP MLP block with fc1, activation, and fc2 layers for feedforward transformation
